name: A3144
title: Hall-effect magnet switch, KY-003

pins.name: OUT
pins.desc: LOW while a magnet is near

notes: Open-collector output: LOW near a magnet's south pole, needs a pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP or the module's).
Needs 4.5 V or more: power from 5 V; the output is safe on 3.3 V boards with INPUT_PULLUP.
